contests.title: RevenueCat Shipaton 2026
contests.description: Welcome to the RevenueCat Shipaton — the mobile hackathon that's all about shipping… a ton. At RevenueCat, we're all about supporting developers to build and monetize amazing apps. After the overwhelming success of last year's Shipaton, we're thrilled to announce the return of our global hackathon — and this year, we're going bigger than ever. This August and September, we're inviting builders from all corners of the globe to ship new apps and compete for over $700,000 in cash prizes and truly unique rewards — over $1 million worth of prizes in total. The challenge Ship a brand-new app to the App Store, Google Play Store, or — new this year — the Samsung Galaxy Store, between August 1st and September 30th, 2026. Integrate the RevenueCat SDK to power at least one in-app purchase or serve ads through RevenueCat Ads. Our goal is to give you that final push to ship that project you've had in the back of your mind but never took the time to get started. Note: Updates to previously released apps won't qualify - it's all about bringing something new to life! You can brainstorm, build, and post before August 1st, but your app must be released for the first time during the Shipaton window. Bigger and better Last year's Shipaton blew us away. Hundreds of new apps launched, thousands of #BuildInPublic posts went out, communities from Tokyo to Seoul to London hosted Shipaton IRL events, and winning teams ended up on stage in New York, accepting their Shippy trophies with their apps lighting up a Times Square billboard. Inspired by your amazing contributions, we've upped the ante for 2026: Over $700,000 in cash prizes — and growing as more sponsors join. Winning apps featured on giant billboards in Times Square. Flights to New York City for the Shippies red carpet award ceremony and RevenueCat's App Growth Annual conference. Press coverage for winners on 9to5Mac and 9to5Google. NEW: Investor exposure through the Shipaton Growth Fund. Categories Grand Prize: Goes to the app that gains the most user traction and growth momentum during the event. We want to hear about what you've done post-release to push your app growth to the next level. [NEW] Next Gen Award: A student-only category for the best app submitted by active students — high school, university, bootcamp, campus dev club, anyone learning the craft. Judged on a video submission and open-source code, so no paid Apple or Google developer account is required. Open to students 13 and up. If you're under the age of majority where you live, a parent or guardian just needs to consent and agree to the rules on your behalf. Learn more on the Next Gen page. [NEW] Catvertising Award: Celebrates the most creative and effective use of RevenueCat Ads as a monetization method. We're looking for clever placements, smart integration with the rest of the revenue stack, and an experience users don't hate. [NEW] Best Game Award: For the best mobile game shipped during the event. We're looking for great gameplay, art direction, and a monetization fit that suits the genre. #BuildInPublic Award: For developers who share the most interesting development journey on social media. We're looking for compelling lessons learned or clever ideas that came from engaging with the community. HAMM Award (Help Apps Make Money): RevenueCat exists to "Help Apps Make More Money". This award goes to the project that designs the most robust and creative monetization strategy. RevenueCat Design Award: For the app that best represents the craft of app development — regardless of business potential. We're looking for innovative ideas and/or beautiful app design and animations. RevenueCat Peace Prize: Awarded to the project that provides the greatest social good. We're looking for apps with big benefits to communities or society at large. Conflict of Interest Award: A special category for RevenueCat employees and sponsors who couldn't resist joining the fun. No cash prizes, but a shot at glory. Influencer Award — Productivity: Christopher LawleyFor a polished productivity app that gives Apple power users one fast, focused place to save and retrieve reusable text snippets, documents, files, and images. Judges will consider product focus, speed, organization, intelligent features, and the quality of the overall design. Influencer Award — Nutrition & Healthy Eating: Abbey’s KitchenFor a flexible nutrition app inspired by Abbey’s Hunger Crushing Combo framework. Judges are looking for a compassionate, practical experience that helps users create more satisfying meals in real-life situations without calorie counting, macro tracking, or restrictive meal plans. Influencer Award — Yoga & Fitness: Simone ShariceFor a personalized wellness companion that answers, “What should I do today?” Judges will consider how effectively the app turns movement, Pilates, recovery, and other wellness needs into a clear, achievable daily plan without creating more information overload. Influencer Award — Career Coaching: Leadership HeatherFor an app that helps new managers practise difficult workplace conversations before the stakes are real. Judges are looking for realistic scenarios, useful feedback, confidence-building experiences, and active practice with situations such as feedback, boundaries, and saying no. Influencer Award — Gaming: Mr Lewis Blogs GamingFor a gaming bucket-list app that makes it easy to save games at the moment of discovery. Judges will consider how effectively users can organize, complete, rate, and share games, along with whether managing a backlog feels enjoyable rather than like another chore. Ship Kotlin Everywhere — JetBrainsRecognizes a creative, polished app built for both iOS and Android using Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, or both. Judges will consider cross-platform quality, consistency, and effective use of Kotlin. Optional consideration may be given to useful build content and contributions to the Kotlin Multiplatform community. Most Viral App — NoiseAwarded to the app that captures the most attention in its market through high-quality, scalable content that converts into downloads. Judges will consider virality, whether the creative formats can be repeated at scale, and how clearly the content communicates the app’s value and addresses users’ needs. Best App for Galaxy — SamsungRecognizes a high-quality app published on the Galaxy Store and thoughtfully optimized for Samsung Galaxy users. Judges will consider the overall app experience and Galaxy-specific optimization, including foldable-device support, Samsung features, and device performance. Galaxy Store exclusivity may receive bonus consideration but is not required. Replit’s Idea to IncomeRecognizes a project that uses Replit to turn a new idea into a live, monetizing mobile app. Judges will primarily consider consistent week-over-week growth in revenue and transactions, supported by paying-user traction, product craft, visual design, and meaningful community engagement. Keep Them Coming Back Award — OneSignalRecognizes an app that uses OneSignal thoughtfully to bring users back. Judges will consider the quality and stability of the implementation, the value it adds to the user experience, and how creatively the app uses campaigns, push notifications, Journeys, or advanced messaging capabilities. The Growth Loop Award — LayersRecognizes a team that treats growth as a process of testing, measuring, learning, and improving. Judges will consider the clarity of the audience and growth hypothesis, how Layers was used to run and observe a focused experiment, whether the SDK was installed correctly, and what the team learned or would try next. Funnel Vision Award — StripeRecognizes a project that launches a web funnel using RevenueCat Funnels and Stripe. Judges will consider the qualifying web payment volume processed during the measurement period and whether the funnel is thoughtfully designed, functional, and effectively implemented. Prize structure You can find the official details of prizes at the bottom of this page, but here's how it all breaks down: Grand Prize Winner $100,000 Trip to New York City for the Shippies award ceremony and RevenueCat's App Growth Annual conference Custom Shippy trophy (presented live on stage!) App featured on a massive Times Square billboard Media spotlight on 9to5Mac and 9to5Google #BuildInPublic Category 1st Place: $30,000 + custom Shippy trophy + Times Square billboard feature + media spotlight + Trip to New York City for the Shippies award ceremony and RevenueCat's App Growth Annual conference 2nd Place: $20,000 3rd Place: $10,000 OneSignal's Keep Them Coming Back Award winner 1st Place: $25,000 + custom Shippy trophy + Times Square billboard feature + media spotlight 2nd Place: $15,000 3rd Place: $5,000 All Other Categories 1st Place: $20,000 + custom Shippy trophy + Times Square billboard feature + media spotlight 2nd Place: $10,000 3rd Place: $5,000 Supported by the industry This year, our sponsors have shown up big. Huge thanks to Replit, OneSignal, JetBrains, Layers, Noise, Stripe, and Samsung for coming in as category sponsors for Shipaton 2026. And more sponsors are joining the fun all the time, which means bigger cash prizes and more additions to the Ship Kit. Ship Kit is back: Freebies for every Shipaton participant Ship Kit is your bundle of tools, credits, deals, and resources from our sponsors to help you build faster, launch better, and save a lot of money along the way. Some deals are while supplies last, so the sooner you register at the top of this page, the sooner you get access as Ship Kit starts to roll out. The #ShipatonSale If you have an app, tool, service, course, or template that could help Shipaton builders, run a sale for participants and share it with the #ShipatonSale hashtag. Submit it on the Shipaton website and we'll list community sales for everyone to find. Even if you're not competing, there are ways to support the builders who are. Shipaton IRL: Events near you We're excited to take Shipaton directly to developers around the world with Shipaton IRL. Last year, builders gathered in Tokyo, Seoul, London, St. Louis, Barcelona, Delhi, Vancouver, Warsaw, Skopje, and dozens of cities in between. This year, we want even more: kickoff parties, co-working days, weekend build sprints, launch-day meetups, and campus hackathons. Check out the events page regularly, as new events are being added all the time! Want to host a Shipaton event yourself? Apply now - we'd love to support you. Approved hosts get a Meetup-in-a-box with Shipaton swag, food vouchers, and organizer resources, and we'll promote your event to the massive Shipaton audience. Perfect for developer communities, hacker clubs, and student organizers planning campus events. Join the conversation on Discord! Shipaton isn't just about shipping code - it's about community. Whether you're brainstorming your first idea or prepping for launch day, the official Shipaton Discord is the place to connect, collaborate, and share the journey. Inside, you'll find fellow builders from around the world debugging code, running paywall experiments, discussing launch strategies, and more. Looking to form a team? Need quick feedback? Want to hang out with other shippers? You'll find it here. We've also created a dedicated #post-engagement-boost channel where you can share your YouTube videos, posts, and other #BuildInPublic content so other participants can like, comment, or share to help you reach a bigger audience. It's all about creating a positive, encouraging space where we lift each other - and help each other ship. Shipaton Livestreams Throughout the event, we'll host twice-a-week livestreams with expert guests, practical sessions, and live Q&A — so you're never building alone for two months. Come say hi 👋 and make the most of Shipaton! Ready, set, ship! Submissions open on August 1st and close on September 30th. Be sure to carefully review all submission requirements to ensure your app qualifies. We're beyond excited to see what the global builder community creates this year. Register today, and we'll keep you updated via the email address you use there. Let's get shipping!

contests.title: Agents for Humans Hackathon
contests.description: Every day, people lose hours to small, repetitive tasks like paying bills, scheduling meetings, or filling out the same paperwork again. On their own they're minor, but together they drain real time and attention. AWS wants to help you change that! Build an AI agent with the Strands Agents SDK that handles routine and repetitive tasks in the background. Instead of another app people open and manage, the agent runs autonomously and only surfaces when there's a real decision to make. This theme is open to any part of life, from home and work to health, money, errands, and family. Whatever you want to solve, there's a track for it. Six weeks. One build. We're looking forward to seeing what you create. Why Join? 🏆 Compete for $40,000 in cash prizes across three tracks 🌐 Build with Strands Agents SDK, open source, production ready, built and trusted by teams at AWS🛠️ Solve real problems people actually deal with, from daily chores to professional workloads to community logistics💳 Get $50 in AWS credits to cover your build costs (go to the Resources tab for request form)🌍 Open to developers worldwide, solo or team, new or seasoned📝 Earn bonus points by publishing your build story on builder.aws.com (see rules for details)

contests.title: Build, Ship, Shape: Amazon Developer Hackathon
contests.description: Welcome to the Amazon Developer Hackathon For the first time, Fire TV, Alexa+, Ring, and Bee are all part of one global hackathon. Build for one product or use several to connect the living room, the front door, and the cloud. Get started now with our SDKs, simulators, and sample code. New to building for Amazon devices and services? We'll help you get from idea to submission with documentation and live office hours. Use our AI tools to prototype and troubleshoot along the way. Choose a track and show off what you build! 🚀 Why join? Be part of the first hackathon where Fire TV, Alexa+, Ring, and Bee are all open to outside developers at once Your product feedback goes directly to the teams building Fire TV, Alexa+, Ring, and Bee Compete for a share of $190K value of cash and AWS credits, plus a 1:1 meeting with the Amazon Developer team for track winners Get Started Pick your track: Fire TV, Alexa+, Bee, or Ring Set up the developer environment for your track (see Resources) Review the track details and requirements to start building Submit your working demo, code repo, and product feedback by the deadline

contests.title: Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon
contests.description: Welcome to the Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon Build a working AI system on open, independent infrastructure, and own the whole thing. The NVIDIA x Nebius Global AI Hackathon is for AI builders, ML engineers, founders, and anyone shipping practical, high-performance AI. You'll build with NVIDIA open source models served on Nebius through Nebius Token Factory, on high performance GPU infrastructure. Experiment with new ideas, push the boundaries of open source AI, and submit a project for a chance to win prizes and recognition. Join fellow builders for technical onboarding, casual workshops, team formation, focused build time, and feedback as you participate in the Global AI Hackathon. Find your nearby city/event here!

contests.title: CALL-E: Your Code Is Calling
contests.description: About the challenge CALL-E is a developer-first platform for building AI agents that make real phone calls and get real-world tasks done. Instead of stopping at text, your agents can plan a call, dial out, hold a natural conversation, adapt in real time, and return structured results you can act on — all through CALL-E's SDK, API, and MCP. In other words: your agents can finally pick up the phone (and actually get something done while they're on the line). ☎️ In CALL-E: Your Code Is Calling, you'll put that to work. Build and deploy a functional application that uses CALL-E to solve a real business or project problem — customer outreach, appointment scheduling, lead qualification, service coordination, workflow automation, or something no one's tried yet. Whether you're an AI engineer, agent builder, or technical founder, this is your chance to push a brand-new platform in directions its makers haven't imagined, share feedback that shapes the roadmap, and compete for a share of $10,000 in prizes. Why join Build something real. Ship an AI agent that completes actual tasks over the phone — not a demo that just generates text. Work with a new platform first. Get hands-on early with CALL-E's SDK, API, MCP, CLI, or SKILL, and help shape what it becomes. Shape the roadmap. Your feedback and bug reports go straight to the CALL-E team, with prizes for the most useful input. Compete for $10,000 in cash prizes, plus meetings with the CALL-E team, blog features, and CALL-E credits. Get started Install CALL-E and sign in (5 min) by following the installation guide. You'll get a CALL-E account with 20 free calls automatically. Need more? Request additional calls via this form. Connect it to your agent via MCP, SDK, API, CLI, or SKILL using the integration guide (~30 min). Browse example skills and apps and brainstorm your build (30 minutes)
